entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, agent ID 301. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac, I'd like to start a return for an order I received last week.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?

Great, thank you. I see the order here for one Trail Helmet in Alpine Green. I see it was delivered seven days ago. To start the process, could you tell me a bit more about the reason for the return? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's just a preference. The helmet is still in the box, completely unopened. To be honest, the color wasn't quite what I was expecting from the pictures online.

I understand completely. Sometimes the lighting in photos can make a color look a little different. And just to confirm, there's no issue with the fit or any of the safety features, since you haven't tried it on?
Correct. I'm sure the safety is excellent, that's why I chose VeloFit. It's purely an aesthetic thing. The box is unopened, so it's in perfect condition.

No problem at all. Since you received the helmet just seven days ago and it's a standard apparel item, you are unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. I can go ahead and email you a pre-paid return label right now. Once we receive the item, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method.

That's great, I appreciate it. Now, since I have to go through the trouble of packaging this up and dropping it off, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next order? I'm planning to buy the same helmet in a different color.

I understand the request, and it's great to hear you're sticking with VeloFit. However, our policy only allows for the full refund on the returned item itself. We aren't able to provide additional discounts or credits for a standard preference-based return.
I see. Not even a 10% off code for the inconvenience? It would guarantee you another sale today.

I do apologize, but my system is firm on this. The best I can do is ensure this return process is as smooth as possible for you. I've just sent that return label to the email we have on file. You should see it in the next few minutes.
Alright, that's fair enough. I had to ask. A full refund is what I called for, so thank you for getting that sorted out quickly.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
